authority_and_clarification_contract: ASR is a separately typed auxiliary model, not a GGUF/text profile or persistent text selection. Its independently signed model pack/catalog and exact runtime/image/machine qualification use existing model custody, not a new signing root.

Finite30minute Admin model-import purpose copies the exact image-owned auxiliary bytes inertly; no unsigned/default activation is introduced. Every actual transcription uses fresh finite Infer, exact audio/model/runtime/resource-generation binding and continuous original authorization checks.

Explicit lab-candidate metadata is an unsigned proposal naming an actual software test-report digest; its intended usable capability declarations need existing custody signatures and execution/interactive certificates. It never creates certificates, admits a model or proves native qualification.

A transcript is escaped untrusted data. The user must review/correct it before a separate human-authored text prompt enters a newly admitted text-model conversation. No raw PCM is silently forwarded and no model response invokes an effect.
Saved image/screen/video PNG inputs are parsed without extraction, with strict member order/bounds, actual image validation, exact capture ID/index/digest and no latest-reference inference.

Human visual clarification explicitly chooses a complete immutable owner/artifact/version and performs a separate actual native Read/reopen. Only a bounded historical text snapshot and human-described sample metadata may enter a fully displayed/digest-confirmed new text-only inference. No pixels, OCR or machine-verified semantic linkage is claimed.

Speech output is explicit rule-based local output, not neural inference authority. Render opens no audio device; Play is separately consented and bounded; uncertain worker cleanup retains ownership and refuses renewal.
